tasks.name: Facebook events ← WeDance
tasks.description: Checks every upcoming SBS event on WeDance. Creates any missing event in the BACHATA CLUB Nights Facebook group (and invites the group), and updates existing ones whose name, time, place, description or poster no longer match WeDance.

tasks.name: Follow batch
tasks.schedule: Daily 12:13, 16:13, 20:13 (Helsinki) · max 20 per run, 60 per day
tasks.description: Follows followers of other Helsinki dance accounts who have a profile picture and haven't been followed before, 60-120 s apart. Any sign of throttling pauses all Instagram tasks for 48 h. Never unfollows.

tasks.name: Followers sync
tasks.description: Saves who follows @bachataclubnights and who it follows (on this PC, not here), counts new followers, lost followers and follow-backs, and updates the follow-back rate.

tasks.name: Bio: next party date
tasks.schedule: Daily 11:47 (Helsinki) · logs only when it changes something or needs you
tasks.description: Keeps 'Next event: DD/MM/YYYY' in the Instagram bio on the next WeDance party. Changes only the date; if the bio was rewritten by hand it leaves it alone and warns.

tasks.name: Friday party highlight
tasks.description: After each WeDance party, puts all archived stories from Friday to Monday into one new highlight 'Night N (DD.MM.)'. Counts first and saves only if the selection matches exactly. Never edits existing highlights.

tasks.name: Unfollow clean-up
tasks.schedule: Sundays 14:13 (Helsinki) · max 30 per run · first run waits for Simon's OK
tasks.description: Unfollows accounts that the follow batch followed 21+ days ago and that never followed back. Never touches older follows (friends, venues, partners) or anyone on the keep list. Skips if the follower lists are more than 36 h old.

tasks.name: Party Notes (DM bubble)
tasks.schedule: Daily ~10:10 (Helsinki) · posts 2 days before, the day before and on the party day
tasks.description: Posts a 24-hour Instagram Note above the DM inbox: 2 days before ('Fri 15.01 BACHATA CLUB Night 💃 21:00') , the day before ('Tomorrow! BACHATA CLUB Night 🕺 21:00') and on the party day ('Tonight! BACHATA CLUB Night 🔥 21:00'). Text built from WeDance, no venue, default cloud colour.
